description.en: The question to ask the AI.
description.de: Die an die KI zu stellende Frage.

description.en: UseInternet — `"true"` to enable Brave Search internet access. Default: `"false"`.
Location — `"true"` to enable geolocation access. Default: `"false"`.
Language — Language for the AI response (e.g. `"German"`, `"English"`). Appends
ResponseLanguage — Two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g. `"de"`, `"fr"`). Forces the AI
Specialist — Name of a specialist model registered via `AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX`
description.de: Specialist - Name eines Spezialmodells, registriert über AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX.

description.en: FilterResults — `"true"` to enable PII filtering on Brave Search queries.
description.de: FilterResults - "true" aktiviert die PII-Filterung bei Brave-Search-Anfragen.

description.en: JsonParse — `"true"` to parse the AI response as JSON. Default: `"false"`.
description.de: JsonParse - "true" parst die KI-Antwort als JSON. Standard: "false".

Summary.en: This Element-Placeholder acquires the AI response to a question.
Summary.de: Dieser Element-Placeholder holt die KI-Antwort auf eine Frage.
